name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Between Bass and Carp, one goes with Esther and the other with Gus.
Bass goes with exactly one of Esther, Royce, or Cedarmere.
Grayreach does not go with Royce if and only if either someone in the Pike Family goes with Grayreach or the angler who landed the Crappie does not belong to the North Watershed (but not both).
Between Royce and Foxglen, one goes with Carp and the other with Crappie.
Either Pinehollow goes with Dale or someone in the Sunfish Family goes with Foxglen (but not both).

hints.text: Suppose Dale went with Bass — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Dale goes with Bass.
Bass goes with Dale, so Esther can't go with Bass.
Bass goes with Dale, so Gus can't go with Bass.
…but now the clue “Between Bass and Carp, one goes with Esther and the other with Gus” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Dale does not go with Bass.
